label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee celebration/surprise for the mayor, including eight lanterns in the town hall great hall and preparing and delivering 200 fresh loaves to the feast tables; neighbour was to escort the mayor there at 18:00. The mayor was intentionally kept unaware until then. Baker helped with the oven and donated wheat; innkeeper and freight coordinated procurement and baking; builder installed lanterns and helped bake/carry; neighbour helped carry and escort.
